name: AX-cmd-05 LC-3 Lunar Lander Crew Cabin -- modern interior (full)
frame: Godot Y-up, metres; same origin as the exterior GLB; node +Y = direction, node +Z = up

gravity.note: on the Moon: 1.62 m/s^2 toward -Y (floor down), pilots standing in restraints between windows 1/2 and 3/4, passengers in the back-wall jump seats; powered descent / ascent: thrust acceleration along +Y; coast zero-g

exterior_hide_note: none needed: the interior adds its own inner panes (window_glass stays; optional hide listed in the handoff iva.json)

hatch_door_1.note: outward-opening side hatch, hinge on the +X edge (outer face); rotate with the exterior mesh hatch_door_1 about node_hatch_door_1_hinge

hatch_door_2.note: docking hatch opens into the cabin, hinge on the CAD +Y edge of the tunnel

egress_paths.method: voxel widest path (3 cm grid) from each occupant's envelope volume into the hatch keep-out volume (side hatch: opening x 0.06-0.8 m inboard; docking: r<=0.45 from 0.35 m below to 0.05 m above the tunnel mouth); clear diameter = 2 x bottleneck clearance to the nearest item surface or IML; egress pose = moving parts at egress_folded
